about.metaDescription: Learn about chatflow-agent, the lightweight async multi-agent Python framework created by Gustavo Baranda, its design principles, and its open source community.
about.title: About chatflow-agent
about.subtitle: A lightweight, asynchronous Python multi-agent framework designed for building conversational workflows with native handoffs and multi-channel connectivity.
about.originP1: chatflow-agent was created to address a clear gap in conversational AI development: connecting LLMs to real-world communication channels without introducing bloated, monolithic orchestration layers.
about.originP2: Instead of imposing complex distributed systems, chatflow-agent focuses on pure Python simplicity, asyncio-based execution, and SQLite-backed session persistence. In stable v0.3.4, rollback restores history for ordinary exceptions; it is not a full-state or cancellation guarantee.
about.p1Desc: Built on standard Python asyncio, with turns for the same in-process session serialized by an asynchronous lock.
about.p2Desc: Orchestrate context-aware transitions between specialized agents seamlessly, preserving history and conversational context.
about.p3Desc: Connectors and integration patterns for WhatsApp, Telegram, signed webhooks, and command-line interfaces. Production deployments still require provider-specific hardening and operational controls.
about.p4Desc: Built-in SQLite persistence and per-session turn serialization within one process and event loop. Cross-thread, multi-process, and distributed deployments require additional coordination.
about.creatorBio: Architect and lead maintainer of chatflow-agent. Designed the core async multi-agent runtime, native handoff mechanisms, and channel adapters to make robust conversational AI accessible to developers worldwide.
about.communityDescription: chatflow-agent thrives thanks to contributions from the global open-source community. Developers, translators, testers, and users worldwide help improve the framework with every release.
about.closingTitle: Ready to Build Conversational Multi-Agent Systems?
about.closingSubtitle: Explore our comprehensive documentation or join discussions with the developer community on GitHub.

home.heroTitle: Build Chatflows and Contextual Multi-Agent Systems in Python
home.heroSubtitle: Build chatflows in Python with agents that use tools, delegate tasks through handoffs, and preserve conversation context across sessions.
home.chatflowConcepts: How a chatflow works in Python
home.installSubtitle: Install the published package and get a persistent multi-agent runner operational in under a minute.
home.docsDiscoverySubtitle: Comprehensive guides, architecture overviews, and verified Python examples for every stage of your conversational workflow.
home.docCard1Desc: Set up your Python virtual environment, install chatflow-agent, and configure provider credentials.
home.docCard2Desc: Architect specialized agents, configure runner lifecycle, and delegate conversation turns deterministically.
home.docCard3Desc: Integrate incoming webhooks with HMAC signatures, deploy with FastAPI, and connect real-time channels.
home.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to deploy reliable multi-agent applications without monolithic orchestration bloat.
home.featHandoffsDesc: Seamless context-aware delegation between specialized agents while preserving conversation history and state.
home.featChannelsDesc: Built-in channel adapters for WhatsApp, Telegram, Webhooks with HMAC signature verification, and interactive CLI.
home.featModelsDesc: Works out of the box with Google Gemini, Gemma, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and xAI Grok with unified configuration.
home.featMemoryDesc: Built-in SQLite persistence, conversational turn history, turn rollbacks, and sequential execution preventing race conditions.
home.featAsyncDesc: Built natively on Python asyncio to handle concurrent messaging traffic and real-time webhook streams with low overhead.
home.featToolsDesc: Equip agents with custom Python functions, automatic schema generation, and safe execution within multi-turn dialogues.
home.communityTeaserDesc: chatflow-agent is an open-source project released under the MIT License, created and led by Gustavo Baranda with contributions from developers worldwide.
home.learnMoreAbout: Learn more about the project & maintainer

notFound.title: Conversation flow reached an unmapped route
notFound.description: The agent attempted a context handoff, but this path does not exist in the session graph. It may have been moved, renamed, or is currently under active development.

error.title: Conversation flow encountered an unexpected error
error.description: An unexpected exception halted processing in this route segment. The error boundary contained the failure and no sensitive information was exposed.

community.howToContributeSubtitle: We welcome contributions of all kinds — code, documentation, bug reports, and feedback. Here is how to get started:
community.step1Desc: Fork the official repository on GitHub and clone your fork locally to begin development.
community.step2Desc: Create a virtual environment with Python >= 3.10 and install the package with development dependencies using pip.
community.step3Desc: Follow strict typing, adhere to async best practices, write comprehensive unit tests, and verify tests pass.
community.step4Desc: Open a descriptive Pull Request referencing any related issues and following Conventional Commits format.
community.guidelinesNoticeDesc: chatflow-agent is an open source project distributed under the MIT License and led by Gustavo Baranda. All collaboration, issue tracking, and roadmap discussions take place transparently on GitHub.
